instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "End a person's email course subscription from the token in their unsubscribe link, so no further lesson is sent", and give it token.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:stop-an-email-course and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give token (the unsubscribe token in the link the person was sent).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: email-course-token (records:read); email-course-subscription (records:read, records:write).
